summary: Registered MCP methods use explicit outer-ring hooks; fallback on_message only covers unknown request/notification methods.
tools/list, tools/call, resources/read, prompts/list, and prompts/get now have explicit hooks.
The eval does not justify a transport wrapper because registered handler coverage is complete through explicit call sites.

notes: on_list_prompts and on_get_prompt are implemented as explicit middleware hook call sites.
on_message remains documented and tested as fallback-only for unknown requests/notifications.
